content: {"summary":"fraud-scorer-02 was OOMKilled within minutes after each restart because the Deployment lacked WEB_CONCURRENCY, causing gunicorn to spawn a worker per CPU (32) which quickly exhausted the 3 GiB memory limit.","likely_cause":"Missing WEB_CONCURRENCY setting leading to 32 gunicorn workers and rapid memory consumption","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Without WEB_CONCURRENCY the pod started 32 gunicorn workers, matching the 32‑core node.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"starts one gunicorn worker per CPU it can see: 32"},{"text":"Setting WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 reduced workers to 16 and stopped the OOM loop.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 set in the Deployment; rollout 02:40 both pods running 16 workers"}],"next_checks":["Verify WEB_CONCURRENCY is defined in the fraud-scorer Deployment manifest for all environments","Monitor memory usage after pod restarts to ensure it stays below the 3 GiB limit","Check redis-features latency that could cause cache growth (RB-006#0)","Review CPU limits and worker counts to avoid CFS throttling (RB-002#0)"]}
